feeds.title: Southern Hospitality Weddings & Events Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ashley, boss lady of Southern Hospitality Weddings & Events! We are a full-service event coordination company based on the beaches of the Outer Banks in North Carolina but travel worldwide to plan events! Follow along with the blog for real weddings, styled shoots, wedding trends & inspiration from the Outer Banks!

feeds.title: Southern California Bride
feeds.description: Southern California Bride is a wedding inspirational blog that focuses on weddings, engagement sessions, styled shoots and all other wedding-related events that happen anywhere from San Luis Obispo to San Diego; from the mountains and desert to the coast.

feeds.title: The Southern Wedding Collective Blog
feeds.description: The Southern Wedding Collective is an online marketplace that connects engaged couples with reputable venues and vendors. These folks know what they are doing and create wedding experiences your guests will rave about for years to come.

feeds.title: Heart of NC Weddings Blog
feeds.description: For over 30 years, Heart of NC Weddings has served as the wedding planning magazine and resource guide for brides in the heart of North Carolina. From the only Triangle Area wedding planning guide, our blog features tips, inspiration & real weddings in Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill & NC.
